test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 6: Student Reviews and Plans
test_cases.test_case_title: Student Logs In to Review Calendar
test_cases.pre_condition: A student account with the email 'student_newuser@example.com' and password 'NewStudent123!' is registered and enrolled in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The student is currently on the Landing Page, having previously logged out. The FullTeaching system is online and operational.
test_cases.expected_result: The student 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page, where they can see their courses and access the calendar. The system displays the Dashboard Page with the course listing.
test_cases.post_condition: The student is logged in and on the Dashboard Page, with their session initiated. The Dashboard displays their enrolled courses and provides access to the calendar feature.
